meta.title: Yoyo — rent anything from people nearby
meta.description: Rent what you need from people nearby and lend out what you rarely use. Chat, sign and pay with a protected deposit on Yoyo.

home.lead: Rent what you need from people nearby. Lend what you rarely use. It always comes back, like a yo-yo.

notFound.title: This page rolled away
notFound.body: We couldn't find what you were looking for. It may have moved, or the link is broken.

styleguide.title: Styleguide
styleguide.intro: Every Yoyo token and component in one place. Switch the theme and the language to check both.
styleguide.heading: Heading
styleguide.caption: Caption
styleguide.cardStaticBody: Paper white, 20 px corners, a 1 px outline and no shadow.
styleguide.cardInteractiveBody: Move the pointer over it: it tilts like a sticker being peeled.
styleguide.fieldEmailHint: We never show it to other people.
styleguide.fieldPriceError: Enter a price of at least €1.
styleguide.stickerHint: Hover to wobble, click to spin.
styleguide.headingSample: Rent it. Use it. Return it.

motion.title: Motion
motion.intro: Scroll slowly: the page changes colour section by section, words fill in, cards stack up, stickers drift. With reduced motion everything here is still.
motion.statement: Rent the drill for a weekend, the tent for a trip, the camera for a wedding. Lend what sits on your shelf. Everything comes back, like a yo-yo.
motion.step1Body: Search for what you need, close to where you are.
motion.step2Body: The deposit is held until the item is back.
motion.step3Body: Return it on time and get your deposit back.
motion.bentoHint: Point at a card: it tips toward you and lifts off its shadow.

error.body: Something broke on our side. Try again, and if it keeps happening, come back in a minute.

register.title: Sign up
register.subtitle: Rent what you need from people nearby, and lend what you rarely use.
register.nameHint: People you rent with will see it.
register.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. A few words in a row work well.

done.title: Email confirmed
done.body: Thank you! Your Yoyo account is ready.

used.title: This link has already been used
used.body: Each confirmation link works once. If you have already confirmed your email, everything is fine.

expired.title: This link is too old
expired.body: Confirmation links work for 24 hours. Ask for a new one and use it soon.

invalid.title: This link does not work
invalid.body: It may be cut short. Open it from the email once more, or ask for a new one.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.body: If there is a Yoyo account for {email}, a link to choose a new password is on its way. It works for 1 hour. Not there? Look in the spam folder.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password for your Yoyo account. You will be signed out everywhere else.
reset.done: Password changed. You are signed in.

changed.title: Password changed
changed.body: Sign in with your new password.

used.title: This link has already been used
used.body: Each reset link works once. Ask for a new one if you still need to change the password.

expired.title: This link is too old
expired.body: Reset links work for 1 hour. Ask for a new one and use it soon.

invalid.title: This link does not work
invalid.body: It may be cut short. Open it from the email once more, or ask for a new one.

profile.title: Profile

profile.aboutHint: A few words about yourself and what you lend.

password.title: Password
password.changed: Password changed. Your other devices are signed out.
password.wrongCurrent: This is not your current password.
password.google: You sign in with Google, so your account has no password to change. Your Google account keeps it safe.

logoutAll.title: Sign out everywhere?
logoutAll.body: Every device signed in to your account, this one included, is signed out at once.
logoutAll.done: You are signed out on every device.
logoutAll.intro: Lost a phone, or signed in on someone else’s computer? End every session at once.

delete.title: Delete your account?
delete.intro: Deleting your account removes your profile and signs you out everywhere. This cannot be undone.
delete.body: Your profile goes for good and you are signed out everywhere. This cannot be undone.

noAccess.title: This page is for administrators
noAccess.body: Your account does not have access here. If you think it should, ask the Yoyo team.

builder.intro: Go through the steps in any order. Everything saves as you type.

stepIntro.photos: Up to 8 photos. The first one is the cover of your card.
stepIntro.basics: What the item is, its category and its condition.
stepIntro.attributes: The details renters of this category look for.
stepIntro.price: What a day costs, a discount for a week or more, and the deposit.
stepIntro.place: Where people pick it up, and the days it is not available.
stepIntro.rules: Your rules for renters, then send the listing for review.

save.invalid: Fix the marked fields to save them

conflict.body: We stopped saving here so the two versions do not overwrite each other. Load the latest version to keep working. Changes on this page that were not saved yet will be lost.

preview.title: How your card will look

preview.privacy: Renters see the city and district, never the exact point.

crop.hint: Cards show this 4:3 frame. “Upload the whole photo” keeps everything, and the card crops it in the middle.

price.weeklyHint: In percent, 0 for none. Longer rentals with a discount book more often.
price.depositHint: Frozen while the item is away and returned in full when it comes back as agreed. 0 for none.
price.payoutFor: For {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
price.payoutNote: Renters pay Yoyo’s service fee on top; the deposit goes back to them after the return.
price.payoutWaiting: Fill in a valid price to see what you receive.

rules.customHint: Up to {max} short rules, 3–120 characters each.

place.searchHint: Street and city, like “Brīvības iela 1, Rīga”.
place.noResults: Nothing found. Try another spelling, or put the point on the map.
place.results: {count, plural, one {# place found} other {# places found}}
place.mapHelp: Click the map or drag the pin to set the pick-up point.
place.center: Put the point in the middle of the map
place.privacy: Only you see the exact point. Renters see the city and district.
place.placeHint: Shown on your listing. Filled in from the point; you can change it.

calendar.title: Days it is not available
calendar.hint: Pick the days you need the item yourself. Click a day, or click one and Shift+click another for a period.
calendar.keys: Arrow keys move between days, Page Up and Page Down change the month, Enter marks or clears a day, Shift+Enter marks the period from the last day you marked.

status.DRAFT: A draft: only you can see it.
status.PENDING_REVIEW: We check every listing before it goes live, usually within a day. Changes you make now keep it in the queue.
status.REJECTED: This listing was not published. The reason from our team:
status.REJECTED_next: Fix it, then send it for review again.
status.PUBLISHED: Live in the catalog. Changing the title, description, category, details, condition, photos, your own rules, city or district sends it back to review. Price, deposit, rental days, ready-made rules, the point and the dates do not.
status.HIDDEN: Hidden: renters cannot find it. Show it again whenever you like.
status.ARCHIVED: Deleted. It is kept for past deals and cannot be changed.

submit.title: Send for review
submit.intro: Our team checks the listing, then it appears in the catalog. You get an email either way.
submit.ready: Everything review needs is filled in.
submit.sent: Sent for review. We will email you.

listingActions.archived: Deleted. It is kept for past deals.
listingActions.deleteDraft: It is deleted for good, with its photos.
listingActions.deleteLive: It leaves the catalog for good. We keep it for past deals, but nobody can rent it any more.

myListings.title: My items
myListings.intro: Everything you lend out, from drafts to live listings.
myListings.emptyBody: Add the first thing you rarely use: a drill, a tent, a console. It takes a few minutes, and it saves as you go.
myListings.loadFailed: We could not load your items.

moderation.intro: Listings waiting for review, oldest first. Each decision applies to the version you see here.

moderation.rejected: Rejected. The owner gets the reason by email.
moderation.changed: The owner changed this listing while you were looking at it. The queue now shows the latest version.
moderation.reasonHint: The owner sees it and gets it by email. 10–500 characters.
